note: Closure criteria for prior D3 findings; statuses and verdicts removed.

findings.title: Lease time is sampled before waiting for both run locks

closure_check.method: Run the clock-wait reproduction for new consumption and replay, and a control whose clock remains within validity.
closure_check.expected: Expired callers never receive launch_eligible=true. A committed reservation remains counted. In-window control remains eligible.

findings.title: An unchecked namespace lets replay miss an existing dispatch

closure_check.method: Run the wrong-namespace reproduction, a canonical namespace control, a used-slot control, and symlink/path-alias cases under the declared path policy.
closure_check.expected: Wrong namespace is refused before authority records are appended. A used dispatch in the derived namespace is ineligible.

findings.title: A new controller run resets the repeated-failure guard

closure_check.method: Run the cross-controller reproduction, same-controller refusal, a different-signature control, and another-unit control.
closure_check.expected: The same unit cannot obtain another reservation for the repeated signature. Unrelated units and a permitted distinct correction are not conflated.

findings.title: The clone-baseline digest is copied without checking controller state

closure_check.method: Run the matching/mismatching baseline controls, an empty/missing baseline case with the controller-defined default, and a changed-inventory case.
closure_check.expected: Only a digest computed from the loaded controller state is admitted; mismatch appends no admission or reservation.

findings.title: New reservations do not bind the current attempt or failure signature to controller state

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditCurrentAttemptStateBinding and TestAuditRepeatedFailureOmittedAgainstState against the revised endpoint.
closure_check.expected: Every contradiction refuses without a new reservation. The repeated material signature remains refused when omitted on the wire.

closure_check.method: Run the real-controller boundary, historical replay, resume, admission and last-slot tests with real pending-attempt fixtures.
closure_check.expected: Valid saved requests and historical idempotent replays retain their specified behavior.

findings.title: First consumption grants an already used dispatch ID

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditFreshRequestForUsedDispatch with a directory, file and symlink at runs/<id>, plus an absent-path positive control.
closure_check.expected: Existing or unreadable paths grant no launch; an absent path can grant exactly one charged reservation.

closure_check.method: Re-run final-slot, replay, unknown-launch and charge-conservation tests.
closure_check.expected: No cancellation or charge deletion is introduced; unused reservations remain recoverable.
